title: docs(pm-dispatch): trap-rows bundle in platform readings + write-side bundling paragraph in the runbook
body:
Fixes #8942
Fixes #8813
Fixes #8574
Fixes #8637
Part of #8941 — the procedure half only; its backfill half (the ~26-card incremental move of comment-parked `Blocked-by:` lines into bodies) stays open on that card. #8941 remains open.

**ADR-class surface — human merge only.** This PR edits the PM dispatch skill's operating protocol; per standing practice it must be merged manually by the maintainer, never queued or auto-merged. The maintainer's manual merge is also the veto window for the flagged re-introduction below.

## What lands (rows and prose in Chinese, machine literals English)

`references/platform-readings.md` — API 配额 section:

1. **`list_issues` multi-label OR semantics** (#8942's row): a two-label query returns the union of both labels' holders; the whole-lane single-label read + local intersection is stated as a correctness requirement, not a style preference. The old parenthetical suggesting REST search `label:a label:b` as the AND route is dropped in the same stroke — it pointed at the search channel this bundle otherwise steers away from.
2. **`issue_read` escaping is read-path-only** (#8813's row): decode-before-write round-trips safely (measured on live cards with the pre-write body held for rollback; no double-encoding), echoing the escaped read back is the operation that would corrupt; HTML comments in bodies are silently stripped on write, so anything that must survive is visible markdown.
3. **`Blocked-by:` lines belong in bodies** (#8941's procedure row): single-channel reverse index restored via the decode-before-write procedure; comment-parked lines are backfilled incrementally (bulk sprees explicitly forbidden — rate-limit pressure); the unlock scan does NOT learn a standing comment read.
4. **`list_issue_types` 403 / `issue_write type:` works** (#8574's row): never probe the list first; write known-good values (`Bug`/`Feature`/`Task`) and treat the write-side error as the signal. The honest caveat is preserved verbatim in substance: invalid-value behavior (loud error vs silent drop) is unmeasured — small-sample verify before writing a non-known value.
5. **Unlock-scan hint disposition** (#8637's row — see the flag below): of the two graded options (channel-qualify the old `in:comments` hint vs drop it for the direct-read procedure), the implementer picks the tighter wording: the hint is **dropped** and the scan is pointed at the direct-read procedure (`list_issues` + `issue_read`, body grep). Rationale: with the body channel restored (row 3) the hint's premise — lines living in comments — is gone, and dropping it re-states none of the voided search-channel semantics, keeping the re-introduction surface minimal.
6. **Rate-limit rows**: MCP list family runs on the GraphQL pool (5000/h) — the wall the PMs kept hitting — while REST core (15000/h) is separate and reachable without the gh CLI via `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/rate_limit`; git-first reads over API reads; round-start threshold: graphql remaining under 1000 means the round degrades to git-first + essential writes only.

`references/dispatch-runbook.md` — one new section codifying **write-side bundling**: the bundle anchor carries the full claim (or grading) comment, member cards carry one-line pointers; label flips stay per-card; measured ~2/3 comment-write reduction in one shift. Read side (acceptance, unlock scan) unchanged.

## ⚠️ Flag: partial re-introduction of material voided on 2026-08-14

Member #8637 remains open per this PR only through its `Fixes` line; substantively, its fix touches the same `issue_read` row that the PR voided by the maintainer's ruling (2026-08-14, verbatim, untranslated: 「8508 作废，8636 直接关闭」) would have neighbored, and the reason for dropping the `in:comments` hint traces to the measurements recorded on the voided card. This bundle re-derives the row's wording from the graded member card, not from the voided card, and deliberately picks the disposition (drop, not channel-qualify) that re-states none of the voided search-channel semantics. The skills seat read the maintainer's 2026-08-16 trap-table ruling as satisfying that card's restart trigger — flagged here rather than silently assumed; **declining this PR (or asking for the row's removal) is the veto**.

## Rulings this bundle lands under (verbatim, untranslated)

- Trap-table rows with business need land (maintainer, 2026-08-16): 「如果业务有需求可以收」 — each member row's business need is measured on its own card.
- The rate-limit wall's identity (maintainer, 2026-08-16): the pool the PMs kept hitting is the 「GitHub API 池」.

## Ratchet ceiling raise, line-for-line accounting

Both files sat at headroom 0 at this branch's base (121/121, 216/216 — confirmed by running the ratchet at head). The five graded rows plus the quota facts could not be funded by compressing the surrounding rows without semantic loss (both files already went through the dedicated compression pass that set their ceilings), so this PR takes the minimal raise the ratchet header prescribes, under the two rulings quoted above:

- `platform-readings.md` 121 → 134 (+13): +1 quota bullet gains the MCP-list-family = GraphQL-pool attribution; +3 git-first bullet (curl `rate_limit` form, round-start threshold, git-first principle — it absorbs the old 配额打满 bullet rather than adding a new one); +2 OR-semantics row (union failure shape + local-intersection correctness requirement); +3 escaping rewrite (old 5-line row becomes two rows totalling 8: decode-before-write, HTML-comment stripping, body-channel restoration + incremental backfill + hint drop); +4 new `list_issue_types` row.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` 216 → 223 (+7): new write-side-bundling section — heading, 4 prose lines, 2 blank separators.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the two ledger values only. This third file is outside the two-file surface the dispatch declared, touched under the dispatch's explicit ceiling-raise clause; no other line of the script changes.

## Verification

Full derived gate union run at head `f10158b04` (after the final commit): `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-formula-expressions` (after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/formula...' build` — the gate reads formula's built dist), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (self-test + live: both files at their new ceilings, headroom 0), `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:partof-closing-keyword` self-test, `check:nul-bytes` — all green. Gate re-derivation over the actual changed paths (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` with the three files) adds no family beyond the dispatch-named set and confirms the model tier: "Model tier — MANDATORY: claude-fable-5 (derived from the file surface, not recalled)."

No changeset: `.claude/` + `scripts/` only — nothing releases; `skip-changeset` applied.
